title: A Star Is Flying Out of Our Galaxy at 1,755 km a Second

scenes.text: A star is leaving our galaxy at 1,755 kilometers a second.
That's nearly four million miles an hour.
Astronomers found the star, called S5-HVS1, in 2019.
It was likely flung out after a close encounter with Sagittarius A star, the black hole at the center of the Milky Way.
Dozens of these hypervelocity stars are known. About a thousand may exist in our galaxy.
Stars launched like stones from a sling. A star, thrown by a black hole.
